## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 114 captures during November 2025. This provides the activity position for the month and establishes the volume submitted for review. The recorded total should be considered alongside the image-quality and grading results below. Together, these measures provide a concise view of the site’s operational performance during the reporting period.

The activity record was complete for the month, with no additional activity or service issue identified in the report. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Image quality

Of the 114 captures, 2 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.8. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment, while a small number could not be graded. The ungradable cases should continue to be monitored as part of routine site review.

## Grading

There were 19 referable results during November 2025. The median grading lag was 1 day. This provides the central measure of the time between capture and grading for the month. The grading outcome should be reviewed with the activity and image-quality measures to support ongoing monitoring of service delivery at Oakridge Primary Care.
